hint.text: A film director is the person who is in charge when making a film. Directors give instructions by telling the actor what to do or how to act.

instruction.text: Claire is a film director and Martha is a writer. They are having a meeting because they want to make a new film. Listen to their conversation and fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Hey Martha. I just finished reading the first three ((++scenes setting)) of your new screenplay and I really enjoyed them.
atoms.sound: Hey Martha. I just finished reading the first three scenes of your new screenplay and I really enjoyed them.

atoms.b: Thank you, Claire. I hope you don’t mind that it is about aliens and outer space.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='700ms'/>Thank you, Claire. I hope you don’t mind that it is about aliens and outer space.

atoms.b: No, not at all. I love ((++fictional non-fictional)) stories. I especially like that the two main ((++characters props)) are not human.
atoms.sound: No, not at all. I love fictional stories. I especially like that the two main characters are not human.

atoms.b: Thank you! Since the story mainly takes place in space, will we need many ((++props plants)) to shoot the film?
atoms.sound: Thank you! Since the story mainly takes place in space, will we need many props to shoot the film?

atoms.b: No, not that many. I think the biggest challenge will be to find the right ((++setting drama)) for the scenes. It has to look like the film is actually in space.
atoms.sound: No, not that many. I think the biggest challenge will be to find the right setting for the scenes. It has to look like the film is actually in space.

atoms.b: Good to know. I think we should read through it one more time. Just to make sure we are on the same page.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='700ms'/>Good to know. I think we should read through it one more time. Just to make sure we are on the same page.
